== Biography ==
Peter was born before 1699. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3103]] is assessed at 42% (possible). Peter's 1699 Edinburgh transcript names James Glasgow, cardiner, and Jean Dohe; Scotland's People indexes James Glasgow and Jean Dobie. The 1679 Edinburgh child would be about twenty when Peter was recorded, a feasible generation in the same city. The 1680 same-name child remains an equally viable childhood comparison for the adult cordiner father.

Possible identification with James-3103 specifically; the named adult father James is explicit, but childhood, apprentice and Dobie-marriage identities remain unproved.23/28 May is separate.

Next useful test: Compare the adult cordiner’s marriage/trade records with both 1679 and 1680 children and the separate apothecary apprentice.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F0595199&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929: Peter Glasgow, 23 May 1699, record SCOT/OPR/BAP/0595199]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
